_comment: Per research §9. Marketing routes cache aggressively (HTML 1h, static assets 1y), portal/api/identity routes never cache. Apply via Cloudflare Cache Rules (Rules → Cache Rules in the dashboard, or via API).

rules.name: portal-no-store
rules.description: Authenticated portal + identity + API routes must never be cached at the edge — responses contain per-user data + auth cookies.
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/portal/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/Identity/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_blazor") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_framework"))

rules.name: marketing-static-assets-long-cache
rules.description: CSS / JS / images / fonts have content-hashed filenames after Tailwind build — safe to cache for a year.
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/css/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/js/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/images/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fonts/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_content/"))

rules.name: marketing-html-short-cache
rules.description: Marketing HTML (homepage, pricing, downloads, privacy, etc.) cached at the edge for 1 hour; CI hits the purge API on every deploy.
rules.expression: (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/portal/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/Identity/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_blazor") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/css/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/js/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/images/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fonts/"))

purge_on_deploy._comment: Production CI/CD calls this after every deploy. Token requires 'Cache Purge' scope on the zone — store in CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN env var.
